notes.title: WORLD CUP
notes.content: [h2]Steam Update 1.3.0[/h2][h3][b]🎉 World Cup Event (Live: August 20 – 21)[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Get ready for the [b]World Cup[/b], a yearly live tournament where players compete in-game challenges for [b]exclusive rewards[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]🏆 Only one player wins the [b]Exclusive World Warrior Hat[/b] — stylish and ultra-rare.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538269/df4e1c0ff9d71df5ca1abcb20e504bd832992c91.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🔥 New Progression System[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Earn [b]1,000 points[/b] to trigger a [b]Boss Spawn[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Defeat the boss to unlock the [b]Mini Gun Mod Menu[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Swap mods[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrade fire rate[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Buy armor[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]🛠️ New Mods Unlockable[/b][/h3][p]Unlocked at milestones — add strategy and customization to your loadout:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Shotgunner Mod[/b] (unlocks at 1,000 pts)[/p][list][*][p]Turns your alternate fire into a wide spray shot.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Decoy Mod[/b] (unlocks at 6,000 pts)[/p][list][*][p]Deploys a 5‑second decoy to draw enemy fire.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Coinshot Mod[/b] (unlocks at 6,000 pts)[/p][list][*][p]1% chance per bullet to turn into a collectible coin.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Second Life Mod[/b] (unlock method 6,000)[/p][list][*][p]Revives you from death [b]once per round[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][h3][b]🎩 New Hats & How to Earn Them[/b][/h3][list][*][p]🏆 [b]World Warrior Hat[/b] – Awarded only to the [b]World Cup champion[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]👑 [b]Dev Hat[/b] – Join the Discord and assist in game development (playtesting, feedback, etc.) to earn this [b]exclusive Dev Hat[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Get ready for the World Cup, a yearly live tournament where players compete in-game challenges for exclusive rewards.
Earn 1,000 points to trigger a Boss Spawn.
Defeat the boss to unlock the Mini Gun Mod Menu:
Swap mods
Upgrade fire rate
Buy armor
Shotgunner Mod (unlocks at 1,000 pts)
Turns your alternate fire into a wide spray shot.
Decoy Mod (unlocks at 6,000 pts)
Deploys a 5‑second decoy to draw enemy fire.
Coinshot Mod (unlocks at 6,000 pts)
1% chance per bullet to turn into a collectible coin.
Second Life Mod (unlock method 6,000)
Revives you from death once per round
World Warrior Hat – Awarded only to the World Cup champion.
Dev Hat – Join the Discord and assist in game development (playtesting, feedback, etc.) to earn this exclusive Dev Hat.

notes.title: Block Party update 1.2.0
notes.content:
[b]block party update[/b]

the drone!!
this mod gives you a drone that will hover around you shooting oranges.
no cool down, now ammo count.

blocks!!!!
this mod allows you to place blocks. use them as walls, and platforms.
you get 1 block per kill, get building!!!

the banana painter!!!!
this hat is for content creators, use this mod in vids.

the bucket head!!!!
"WHAT I CANT SEE ANYTHING!!!" this hat gives bananaguy a bucket.
